examples.en: Nobody enjoys having to break bad news to a client.
examples.zh: 没人喜欢去跟客户宣布坏消息。

situation.en: I'll break the bad news on tomorrow's call — with a recovery plan attached.
situation.zh: 项目要延期了，经理让你想想怎么跟客户开口。

examples.en: I promised the demo on Friday and I let the team down.
examples.zh: 我答应周五给演示，结果让团队失望了。

situation.en: Sorry — I know I let you down on this one.
situation.zh: 你跟经理承认这次没兑现承诺。

examples.en: Working remotely, you have to set boundaries or work never ends.
examples.zh: 远程工作必须划清界限，不然工作永远没完。

situation.en: I set boundaries early: no messages after seven unless it's urgent.
situation.zh: 你跟总是深夜发消息的同事委婉说明白天再回。

examples.en: Let's address the elephant in the room: the budget is gone.
examples.zh: 咱们直说那个大家都躲着的问题吧：预算没了。

situation.en: The elephant in the room is that nobody trusts the timeline anymore.
situation.zh: 会上所有人都在绕开核心问题，你决定挑明。

entries.zh: 大家心里都清楚却避而不谈的问题

examples.en: A fifteen-minute call cleared the air between the two teams.
examples.zh: 一通十五分钟的电话，两个团队把话说开了。

situation.en: Let's clear the air before the retro — something feels off.
situation.zh: 你提议跟有摩擦的同事单独聊一次。

entries.zh: 把话说开、消除误会或紧张气氛

examples.en: That one's on me — I approved the change without a test run.
examples.zh: 那件事怪我——我没跑测试就批准了变更。

situation.en: The outage? That one's on me, and here's what I'm changing.
situation.zh: 复盘会上你要主动认下自己的那部分责任。

entries.zh: 那件事怪我、是我的责任

examples.en: I owe you an apology for snapping in yesterday's meeting.
examples.zh: 昨天会上我冲你发火，我欠你一个道歉。

situation.en: I owe you an apology — you were right about the cache all along.
situation.zh: 你想私下跟同事为昨天的态度道歉。

examples.en: We shipped a bug to your users; here's how we'll make it right.
examples.zh: 我们把一个缺陷发到了你们用户那里；下面是我们弥补的办法。

situation.en: Give me until Friday and I'll make it right.
situation.zh: 客户投诉后，你要在回复里给出补救方案。

entries.zh: 把事情弥补好、纠正错误

examples.en: She raised a concern about the security review being skipped.
examples.zh: 她对跳过安全评审这件事提出了担忧。

situation.en: I want to raise a concern about the launch date — respectfully.
situation.zh: 你觉得方案有风险，想在评审会上正式提出来。

examples.en: If the noise continues, we'll have to file a complaint.
examples.zh: 如果噪音还继续，我们就得正式投诉了。

situation.en: He filed a complaint with HR about the on-call schedule.
situation.zh: 你跟邻居沟通无果，考虑走正式渠道。

examples.en: If support can't fix it in a day, escalate the issue to engineering.
examples.zh: 如果客服一天内解决不了，就把问题升级到工程团队。

situation.en: Escalate the issue now — waiting is costing us customers.
situation.zh: 工单卡了三天，你决定往上报。

entries.zh: 把问题升级、上报到更高层

examples.en: Give constructive feedback: name the behavior, not the person.
examples.zh: 给建设性反馈要对事不对人：说行为，不说人品。

situation.en: I'll give constructive feedback in our one-on-one, with examples.
situation.zh: 你要给下属提改进意见，又怕伤到对方。

entries.zh: 给出建设性反馈（对事不对人）

examples.en: Code review comments aren't attacks — don't take it personally.
examples.zh: 代码评审的意见不是攻击，别往心里去。

situation.en: She takes it personally whenever her design gets questioned.
situation.zh: 你安慰被评审意见打击到的新人。

entries.zh: 把（批评）往心里去、当成针对个人

examples.en: Keep your cool when the client raises their voice; answer slowly.
examples.zh: 客户提高嗓门时你要沉住气，慢慢回答。

situation.en: You kept your cool through the whole incident call — impressive.
situation.zh: 同事要跟客户吵起来，你拉他一把。

examples.en: Don't lose your temper in the standup — you'll regret it all day.
examples.zh: 我在站会上发了脾气，后悔了一整天。

situation.en: If you lose your temper in a review, you rarely change anyone's mind.
situation.zh: 你跟朋友复盘今天那场不愉快的会。

examples.en: There's no need to raise your voice — I can hear you fine.
examples.zh: 没必要提高嗓门——我听得很清楚。

situation.en: Once someone raises their voice, the meeting is basically over.
situation.zh: 对方在电话里越说越激动，你想把场面稳住。

examples.en: We disagreed on the design, so we talked it out over coffee.
examples.zh: 我们在设计上有分歧，就喝杯咖啡坐下来谈开了。

situation.en: Whatever it is, let's talk it out like adults.
situation.zh: 你和搭档闹了别扭，决定当面聊清楚。

examples.en: The two teams worked it out without involving management.
examples.zh: 两个团队没惊动管理层，自己协商解决了。

situation.en: Give us an hour in a room and we'll work it out.
situation.zh: 两个组在资源上起了争执，最后私下协调好了。

examples.en: We agreed to disagree on the framework and moved on.
examples.zh: 我们在框架选型上求同存异，然后继续往前走。

situation.en: On tabs versus spaces, we simply agree to disagree.
situation.zh: 争论半小时没结果，你提议先搁置分歧。

entries.zh: 求同存异、各自保留意见

examples.en: Weekend deployments are where I draw the line.
examples.zh: 周末还要上线，这就是我划的底线了。

situation.en: Everyone has to draw the line somewhere on scope creep.
situation.zh: 公司又想加新要求，你要明确哪些不能再让了。

examples.en: Joking about her accent crossed the line.
examples.zh: 拿她的口音开玩笑，这就过分了。

situation.en: Feedback is fine; personal comments cross the line.
situation.zh: 同事的玩笑让你不舒服，你要指出它越界了。

examples.en: Stand your ground on the security requirements, politely but firmly.
examples.zh: 安全要求上立场要站稳——客气，但坚定。

situation.en: Stand your ground on this one — the launch slipping two days is the right call.
situation.zh: 产品经理想砍掉安全评审，你准备顶住。

examples.en: Give me a heads-up before you merge big changes.
examples.zh: 合并大改动之前提前跟我说一声。

situation.en: Just a heads-up: the staging environment resets tonight.
situation.zh: 你希望搭档下次动公共代码前先知会你。

entries.zh: 提前知会、打个招呼提醒一声

examples.en: I need to have a hard conversation with my report about his performance.
examples.zh: 我得跟我下属进行一次艰难的谈话，谈谈他的绩效。

situation.en: Hard conversations get easier the sooner you have them.
situation.zh: 你拖了两周了，今天决定把那次谈话谈了。

examples.en: The feature underperformed — signups were half the forecast.
examples.zh: 这个功能表现不达标——注册量只有预期的一半。

situation.en: Two quarters of underperforming and the product was shut down.
situation.zh: 你要在复盘里客气但准确地指出数据没达标。

entries.zh: 表现不达标、业绩低于预期

examples.en: Sometimes a manager has to let someone go even when it isn't their fault.
examples.zh: 融资告吹之后，他们不得不裁掉三个人。

situation.en: When you let someone go, do it in person and keep it short.
situation.zh: 你在新闻里看到某公司又裁员了。

examples.en: The package included three months of severance.
examples.zh: 补偿方案里包含三个月的离职补偿金。

situation.en: Negotiate the severance — it's standard to ask.
situation.zh: 你向朋友解释被优化时该谈的补偿构成。

examples.en: In the US, giving two weeks' notice is the polite standard.
examples.zh: 在美国，提前两周通知离职是礼貌惯例。

situation.en: I gave my two weeks' notice on Monday, in writing.
situation.zh: 你要向外国朋友解释你打算怎么提离职。

examples.en: She handed in her notice after accepting the remote role.
examples.zh: 她接了那份远程工作之后，递交了辞呈。

situation.en: Hand in your notice only after the new contract is signed.
situation.zh: 你跟朋友说你已经正式提离职了。

entries.zh: 递交辞呈、正式提出离职

examples.en: Bring it up in the retro, not in the middle of the incident.
examples.zh: 这件事在复盘会上提，别在故障处理中间提。

situation.en: I'll bring it up with her directly, not in the group chat.
situation.zh: 你有个敏感问题想找合适的场合说。

examples.en: Stop dancing around the issue — is the launch at risk or not?
examples.zh: 别绕着问题打转了——上线到底有没有风险？

situation.en: He danced around the issue for an hour before admitting the delay.
situation.zh: 对方汇报了十分钟都没说到点子上，你想直问。

entries.zh: 绕着问题打转、回避正题

examples.en: Don't beat around the bush — tell me what the client actually said.
examples.zh: 别拐弯抹角了——把客户原话告诉我。

situation.en: I appreciate directness; please don't beat around the bush.
situation.zh: 同事铺垫了半天，你想听直接结论。

examples.en: Rip the band-aid off: tell the client about the delay today, not Friday.
examples.zh: 长痛不如短痛：今天就跟客户说延期，别拖到周五。

situation.en: She ripped the band-aid off in the first five minutes of the call.
situation.zh: 坏消息拖着只会更糟，你劝经理早说。

entries.zh: 长痛不如短痛、干脆直接说（坏消息）

examples.en: Don't sugarcoat the review — he needs the real picture.
examples.zh: 评审意见别粉饰——他需要知道真实情况。

situation.en: I won't sugarcoat it: the numbers are bad this quarter.
situation.zh: 你请经理给你反馈时直说就行。

entries.zh: 把（难听的话）说得好听、粉饰

examples.en: Honest feedback can still be kind — don't hurt someone's feelings unnecessarily.
examples.zh: 诚实的反馈也可以友善——别无谓地伤人感情。

situation.en: I didn't mean to hurt her feelings with that comment.
situation.zh: 你准备说重话之前提醒自己注意方式。

entries.zh: 伤到某人的感情、让人难受

examples.en: He took offense at the joke even though none was meant.
examples.zh: 那个玩笑本无恶意，他却觉得被冒犯了。

situation.en: No offense was intended — sorry if it landed wrong.
situation.zh: 你解释某个同事为什么突然冷脸了。

examples.en: Holding a grudge after a code review helps nobody.
examples.zh: 因为代码评审记仇，对谁都没好处。

situation.en: He doesn't hold grudges — argue hard, then it's over.
situation.zh: 你劝同事别把上次的争执一直放在心上。

examples.en: They patched things up after a long lunch and an honest talk.
examples.zh: 一顿长午饭加一次坦诚的谈话，他们和好了。

situation.en: Let's patch things up — this silence is helping no one.
situation.zh: 你和搭档冷战了两天，你想主动修复。

examples.en: The two founders buried the hatchet and merged their teams.
examples.zh: 两位创始人放下旧怨，合并了团队。

situation.en: It's time to bury the hatchet and ship the release.
situation.zh: 你形容两个闹翻的合伙人最终和解。

examples.en: Sometimes you swallow your pride and apologize first.
examples.zh: 有时候你得放下面子，先道歉。

situation.en: He swallowed his pride and asked the junior dev for help.
situation.zh: 你知道自己也有错，决定先低头。

examples.en: We learned it the hard way: never deploy on a Friday night.
examples.zh: 我们以惨痛代价学到了：绝不在周五晚上上线。

situation.en: Backups? I learned that the hard way, trust me.
situation.zh: 你在给新人讲团队那条铁律的来历。

examples.en: Don't put him on the spot in front of the client — ask later.
examples.zh: 别在客户面前把他架住——回头再问。

situation.en: She hates being put on the spot in big meetings.
situation.zh: 会上有人突然点名逼同事表态，你觉得不妥。

entries.zh: 让某人当场表态、把某人架住

examples.en: He called out the unfair on-call rotation in the team meeting.
examples.zh: 他在团队会上当众指出了值班轮换不公的问题。

situation.en: Call out the behavior, not the person, if you can.
situation.zh: 你想在会上直接点破那个大家都装看不见的不公。

entries.zh: 当众指出（某人的错误或不当）

examples.en: Don't complain about her behind her back — tell her directly.
examples.zh: 别在背后抱怨她——有话当面说。

situation.en: Decisions made behind the team's back always leak out.
situation.zh: 你发现有人在背后议论同事，你想制止。

entries.zh: 背着某人、在背后（搞小动作）
